title: JNVST Class 6 · 2023 Pattern Paper
description: JNVST Class 6 practice paper on the 2023 pattern: Mental Ability (40 picture questions), Arithmetic (20) and Language (20: two English and two Hindi passages), 80 questions, 100 marks, 120 minutes, no negative marking. questions.explanation: We need the LCM of 4, 6 and 9. 4 = 2 × 2, 6 = 2 × 3, 9 = 3 × 3, so LCM = 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 = 36 minutes.
